EnumThreadWindows sees no host windows and returns success without callbacks.

GetCursorPos supplies fixed (0,0); host cursor is never read or moved.
LoadCursorA/SetCursor/ShowCursor use inert guest cursor handles; no host cursor APIs run.

StretchBlt supports only asserted 1:1 SRCCOPY between top-down guest DIBs.
Main host HWND global9c0010 is opaque guest sentinel1, admitting offscreen list controls; no native desktop window exists.
